descriptionChirho: Feminine noun denoting the 'memorial portion' of a grain offering burned on the altar as a reminder before YHWH (Leviticus 2:2, 2:9, 2:16, 5:12, 6:8, Numbers 5:26). English 'its-memorial-portion / for–a-memorial,' Spanish 'porción–memorial–suya / para–memorial,' Hindi 'स्मरण–अंश–उसका / स्मरण–भाग–के–लिए,' Arabic 'تِذْكَارَهَا / لِ–تَذْكَارٍ,' Korean '그것–의–기념–분 / 기념물–로,' Swahili 'kumbukumbu–yake / kwa–ukumbusho.' The two clusters differ only in grammatical form: construct with pronominal suffix (6x) versus absolute with preposition (1x); the lexical meaning is identical.
